## All India Seminar on Emerging Signal Processing Applications organized by Telangana State Centre of the Institution of Engineers (India)

News Date : 26 Feb 2023News ReportThe Telangana State Centre of the Institution of Engineers (India) recently hosted a Two Day All India Seminar on “Emerging Signal Processing Application” on 24th and 25th February 2023 at “Visvesvaraya Bhavan” in Khairatabad, Hyderabad. This event aimed to bring together experts, scientists, engineers from different sectors of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, industries, academics and research professionals to exchange their knowledge and share their experiences to come up with collaborative projects that benefit all.Dr S P Singh, Professor and Head of ECE department at MGIT, was one of the members of the Technical Committee of the All India Seminar. He played an important role by acting as the Chairman of the Technical Session V, one of the panelists in the panel discussion, and also delivered a Technical Talk on the topic “Radar signal design, application and future challenges”.This All India Seminar provided a great platform for professionals in the field of signal processing to come together and share their insights and perspectives. The event was a great success, and we look forward to more such initiatives in the future.
